text: In September 2022 an investment company of Investindustrial VII L.P. and Eataly S.p.A. signed an agreement under which, at closing, Investindustrial holds 52% of Eataly and the existing shareholders Eatinvest (Farinetti family), the Baffigo/Miroglio family and Clubitaly (Tamburi Investment Partners) own the remaining 48%.
short: Investindustrial holds 52% of Eataly under its 2022 investment agreement.
